主要内容: Imperial Capital Bancorp, Inc. filed an unaudited monthly operating report for February 2012 on March 20, 2012, with the Office of the United States Trustee. The report, not compliant with the Exchange Act, was prepared for the Bankruptcy Court and OUST guidelines. It is preliminary, unaudited, and does not reflect GAAP financial statements. The company warned investors not to rely on the report, as it may be revised and is not indicative of future results. The reorganization plan previously filed with the Bankruptcy Court may not fully pay creditors. Unsecured creditors and common stockholders will receive no assets, and the Bankruptcy Court is expected to extinguish common stock upon plan approval. The report is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filing and includes a monthly operating report for February 2012, signed by Anthony A. Rusnak on March 29, 2012. The Current Report on Form 8-K includes forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties, with no obligation to update them. The report is for informational purposes only and not deemed filed under Section 18 of the Exchange Act.
